title: feat(nm2ax): two-axis opposite seed axis-cover: reverse HOLD, face fails
science: Two-axis opposite seed, y-probes, axis-cover. Load-bearing contrast: on the one-axis seed cover HOLDs at all four y-probes (reverse hold, face hold); adding the second seed pair moves t(D) from 3 to 2, collapses M(D) from a mixed 3-set to {-e_3}, and breaks cover at D (union misses e_2) - so face-cover dies purely from seeding density.
